resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1947 association report gives 1928 for the wooden tower, the 1946 report says the towers were built in 1931, and the Idaho lookout sites and firelookout.com give 1930. A 1931 aerial photograph shows the lookout. The story gives the 1928 date from the association's own 1947 report and names the others. The sources are not reconciled.

The Idaho sites date the 75-foot steel tower to 1948, but the association's 1947 report says the steel replaced the wooden towers that year. The story uses 1947 from the association's report and names the 1948 date.

notes_for_editor: Built date is disputed: 1928 (association's 1947 report), 1930 (firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts), 1931 (association's 1946 report; a 1931 aerial photo shows the lookout). The 1935 100-foot steel tower appears only on firelookout.com and the Idaho site; the association's reports describe wooden lookouts until 1947. Replacement is 1947 per the association and 1948 per the Idaho sites. Removal date is unknown in every source. height_m 22.9 matches the 75-foot post-1947 steel tower; the first pole tower was listed at 85 feet, so the record height may refer to the later tower. Archives West (A.B. Curtis collection) has item-level records of this lookout: a 1931 aerial view, a 1936 oblique aerial view (116th Photo Section, item A 1352) and a 1954 color slide. Rights statements were not checked, so no photo entries are added; footnote 4 points to the collection page, not the item page. The Idaho site and firelookout.com abbreviate the association as CPTPA; the full name comes from the weebly page.
